description: Northstar OS subscription plan catalog — SINGLE SOURCE OF TRUTH (A2 unification). v2 relocates the exact catalog previously hard-coded in Northstar_backend/auth.py::PLAN_ENTITLEMENTS (tier names, prices, gate arrays, descriptions unchanged) and supersedes the older master-brain/subscription-plans.json (v1), which had drifted: autothink was missing autothink_workspace and gate order differed. Both backend loaders (auth.py::PLAN_ENTITLEMENTS and master_brain_subscribers.load_plans()) read this one file; a smoke test fails if they ever disagree. Entitlements declare which live gates a plan WOULD cover for a subscriber. A plan never flips a gate: gates_always_off=true, and executing any live action additionally requires a fresh, named operator approval per action. No uncapped/unmetered promises: named credit classes only (see Early Paid Launch Boundary, PRODUCTION_BLUEPRINT §18).
